typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ETPPDEV_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Source File} as string,
		Name as string,
		{Interval Breakdown} as string,
		DataCenter as string,
		{Parent vCenter} as string,
		{CPU - Total Physical} as double,
		{CPU - Allocated Logical} as double,
		{CPU - P95} as double,
		{CPU - Max} as double,
		{CPU - Average} as double,
		{Memory - Total} as double,
		{Memory - Allocated} as double,
		{Memory - P95} as double,
		{Memory - Max} as double,
		{Memory - Average} as double,
		{Memory - Balloon#1} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ExcelSource
ExcelSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		{CPU_-_Max} as double,
		{Memory_-_Max} as double,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Memory_-_Balloon_1} as double,
		Source_File as string,
		Interval_Breakdown as string,
		{Memory_-_P95} as double,
		{Memory_-_Total} as double,
		Name as string,
		{CPU_-_Allocated_Logical} as double,
		DataCenter as string,
		Parent_vCenter as string,
		{Memory_-_Allocated} as double,
		{CPU_-_P95} as double,
		{CPU_-_Total_Physical} as double,
		{Memory_-_Average} as double,
		{CPU_-_Average} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{CPU_-_Max} = {CPU - Max},
		{Memory_-_Max} = {Memory - Max},
		importdate = ImportDate,
		{Memory_-_Balloon_1} = {Memory - Balloon#1},
		Source_File = {Source File},
		Interval_Breakdown = {Interval Breakdown},
		{Memory_-_P95} = {Memory - P95},
		{Memory_-_Total} = {Memory - Total},
		Name,
		{CPU_-_Allocated_Logical} = {CPU - Allocated Logical},
		DataCenter,
		Parent_vCenter = {Parent vCenter},
		{Memory_-_Allocated} = {Memory - Allocated},
		{CPU_-_P95} = {CPU - P95},
		{CPU_-_Total_Physical} = {CPU - Total Physical},
		{Memory_-_Average} = {Memory - Average},
		{CPU_-_Average} = {CPU - Average}),
	partitionFileNames:[($ETPPDEV_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> ETPPDEV
